title: Let contentment prove your discipline
summary: Real discipline leaves the mind content, humble, and turned to Naam. Let contentment prove your discipline.
lifeApplication: Choose one repeatable cue today and keep it without negotiation, even if it is small enough to feel unremarkable.

source.shortMeaning: Real discipline leaves the mind content, humble, and turned to Naam.
source.lifeApplication: When discipline turns harsh or theatrical, keep only the practice that leaves the heart humbler.

evidence.coreClaim: Real discipline leaves the mind content, humble, and turned to Naam.
evidence.turn: Conquer the mind before trying to conquer the world.
evidence.practicalImplication: Choose one repeatable cue today and keep it without negotiation, even if it is small enough to feel unremarkable.
